results.question: Quel est le score moyen des avis attribués à l'album 'Les Indes Fourbes' ?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM avis a JOIN ouvrage o ON a.ido = o.ido WHERE o.titre = 'Les Indes Fourbes';
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    a.pseudo AS utilisateur,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_avis,
    ROUND(AVG(a.score)::numeric, 2) AS note_moyenne,
    MIN(a.score) AS note_minimale,
    MAX(a.score) AS note_maximale,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avis_positifs,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.score = 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0::numeric END)::numeric / COUNT(*), 2) * 100 AS taux_5_etaires
FROM 
    avis a
JOIN 
    ouvrage o ON a.ido = o.ido
GROUP BY 
    a.pseudo
ORDER BY 
    nb_avis DESC, note_moyenne DESC

results.question: Quels sont les 3 ouvrages ayant la meilleure note moyenne avec au moins 2 avis ?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.titre, AVG(a.score) FROM ouvrage o JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido GROUP BY o.ido, o.titre HAVING COUNT(a.score) >= 2 ORDER BY AVG(a.score) DESC LIMIT 3;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    o.ido,
    o.titre,
    AVG(a.score) AS moyenne_note
FROM 
    ouvrage o
INNER JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido
WHERE 
    a.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    o.ido, o.titre
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    moyenne_note DESC
LIMIT 3

args.sql:
SELECT 
    o.ido,
    o.titre,
    AVG(a.score) AS moyenne_note
FROM 
    ouvrage o
INNER JOIN avis a ON o.ido = a.ido
WHERE 
    a.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    o.ido, o.titre
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    moyenne_note DESC
LIMIT 3;
